text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I can't give you a 
present."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“—Huh? What?! What's the matter all of a 
sudden, Believe-chan?!”

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"It's unfinished. The accessory pouch for 
the gift... That final step just feels so 
far away."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's what it is...! Believe-chan, 
you made this yourself?! Thank you so 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If it's just one last step... is there 
anything I can help with? Just say the 
word, Believe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh... no, I'm fine, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, I figured you'd turn me down! 
But come on, let me do just a little 
something...! Like cleaning, or bringing 
snacks... maybe?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... I think you're putting the cart 
before the horse. This is supposed to be a 
gift for you."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
But... but, but, buuut~!! I feel so bad 
just doing nothing~... Even though you're 
working so hard for my sake...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Then... could you give me some time? Even 
if your birthday passes... will you... 
wait for me?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
What you gave me, um... ...It'll help me 
do an even better job.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...! A-All right! I'll wait, I'll wait!! 
I'll wait with everything I've got for 
you, Believe-chan! ...Thank you so much.
